Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.80 - Synced upstream Wrath Combo (debug-tab status reads, PR #1235 / #1224)
- Debug window: the player and target status lists now share one status-drawing helper and read through SafeStatusList, plus a new Statuses node on the target debug tree. Developer diagnostic view only - no gameplay, targeting, or rotation changes.
- All GluttonyCombo customizations preserved: Amnesia / Pacification / Silence handling, Pyretic / Reflect penalties, 15s raidwide-mitigation gate, WHM ground-heal targeting, SMN Aegis Uptime, BattleData, and IPC controls.
